title: USER AGREEMENT
subtitle: terms of use of the music platform
intro: This User Agreement (the Agreement) governs use of the music platform Site Name (the Platform, the Site). By registering, uploading materials, or using dashboard features, you confirm that you have read and accept the Agreement.

sections.title: 1. Definitions
paragraphs: Platform — the online service that enables publication and consumption of music and other content, subscriptions, digital purchases, and other features described on the Site.
User — a legally capable person who has registered on the Site or uses its features.
User Content — materials the user uploads, publishes, or makes available through the Site, including albums, tracks, stems, lyrics, articles, images, cover art, profile materials, and other files.
Artist — a user who publishes materials on the Site in their own name or on behalf of a band.
Listener — a user who consumes content on the Site without publishing their own materials (unless the account type provides otherwise).

sections.title: 2. User Content
paragraphs: 2.1. The user independently decides what materials to upload and publish on the Site and is responsible for their content and lawful publication.

2.2. By publishing User Content, the user confirms that: (1) they are the rights holder or have all necessary rights and permissions; (2) publication does not infringe third-party rights; (3) they have obtained all necessary consents from authors, performers, co-authors, and other rights holders; (4) the rights granted to the Platform are sufficient for operation of the relevant services.

2.3. A musical work, performance, and phonogram may be separate intellectual-property objects whose rights may belong to different persons. The user must take this into account when uploading and publishing materials.
2.4. The Platform does not become the author, performer, or rights holder of User Content solely because it provides the technical ability to upload and publish such content.

sections.title: 3. License to the Platform
paragraphs: 3.1. By publishing User Content, the user grants the Platform a non-exclusive, royalty-free license for as long as the material remains on the Site, as necessary for operation of the Platform.

3.2. The license covers technically necessary acts: storage; reproduction; making content available; streaming; technical encoding; compression; format conversion; creation of technical copies; displaying covers, images, titles, and artist names; and other technical acts objectively necessary to provide the relevant Site features.
3.3. No exclusive rights to User Content are transferred to the Platform.

sections.title: 4. Copyright and Related Rights. Moderation
paragraphs: 4.1. The user must not publish materials that infringe copyright and related rights, other third-party rights, or requirements of the laws of the Russian Federation.
4.2. The Platform may moderate, restrict access to, or remove materials where grounds exist under this Agreement and applicable law.

sections.title: 5. Removal and Blocking of Content
paragraphs: 5.1. The Platform may restrict access to or remove User Content, including if: a rights-holder complaint is received; there are grounds to believe the material violates the law; the Agreement is breached; there is a security risk; prohibited content is identified; or continued publication is technically or legally impossible.
5.2. The user may stop publishing materials through dashboard features where available on the Site.

sections.title: 6. Information Intermediary and Platform Liability
paragraphs: 6.1. The Platform may act as an information intermediary with respect to User Content to the extent provided by the laws of the Russian Federation.
6.2. The Platform does not conduct prior legal review of all User Content and does not guarantee that it meets the interests or expectations of third parties.

sections.title: 7. Premium Subscription
paragraphs: 7.1. Premium subscription provides access to features and content as described on the Site. Plan terms, duration, and renewal are shown in the Site interface.
7.2. Subscription purchase is available to signed-in users subject to Site requirements (including email verification where applicable).

sections.title: 8. Downloads and Digital Content
paragraphs: 8.1. Purchase of digital content on the Site is also governed by the Public Offer. The buyer receives personal-use rights within the limits stated on the Site and in the offer.
8.2. The user may not distribute, resell, or otherwise use purchased digital content in violation of the rights holder's rights.

sections.title: 9. Marketplace and Physical Goods
paragraphs: 9.1. Where a physical product is sold directly by an artist through Site features, the artist is the seller and is independently responsible for the product, its description, price, delivery, returns, consumer-protection compliance, and applicable tax obligations.
9.2. The Platform may provide technical infrastructure to list offers without assuming seller obligations unless the Site expressly states otherwise.

sections.title: 10. Payments
paragraphs: 10.1. Payments for digital goods, subscriptions, and other services are processed through payment providers available on the Site. Payment details may be entered on the payment provider's side.
10.2. Specific payment transactions may additionally be governed by the Public Offer and payment providers' terms.

sections.title: 11. Personal Data
paragraphs: 11.1. Personal data is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy published on the Site.
11.2. Certain features may require consent to personal-data processing in forms provided on the Site.

sections.title: 12. User Liability
paragraphs: 12.1. The user is liable for User Content, dashboard actions, and consequences of infringing third-party rights, this Agreement, or the laws of the Russian Federation.
12.2. The user shall compensate the Platform for documented losses caused by breach of the Agreement within the limits established by the laws of the Russian Federation.

sections.title: 13. Changes to the Agreement
paragraphs: 13.1. The Platform may amend the Agreement. A new version takes effect on the date stated upon publication unless a different date is specified in the text.
13.2. Continued use of the Site after a new version takes effect constitutes acceptance unless applicable law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 14. Contact
paragraphs: For questions about the Agreement and use of the Site, contact support at {{supportEmail}} (hours: 10:00–19:00 Moscow time).
